objective: Bring the Case of Elunite to Smith Mathiel.

description: I have placed the elunite you gathered into a case.  Take it to the blacksmith Mathiel, and he will craft for you an elunite weapon.
Mathiel is to the south, on the other side of this building.
progress: Greetings, young warrior.  How might my skills serve you?
completion: Ah, elunite ore. This is a fine metal to work with, for it is blessed by the goddess Elune herself. It would be an honor to craft weapons with it.
